$comment: Deptheos design tokens: the one source for brand colors, corners and type. Edit here, then run `node script/tokens.mjs`. See design/README.md.

surface.use: Panels, cards, popovers, top bar, desktop sidebar

surface-sunken.use: Inputs, inline code, segmented controls, panels inside the sidebar

text-segment.use: Labels of the unselected segments of a segmented control: stronger than text-muted, quieter than text

control-border.use: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and off switches (3:1 against surfaces)

accent.use: Actions, links, selection, focus. The app icon's blue. iOS dark uses a deeper blue because iOS puts white labels on the tint

on-accent.use: Text and icons on accent fills

accent-fill.use: The one primary button per screen. Deeper than the dark accent so white text reads on it

on-accent-fill.use: Text and icons on accent-fill (4.9:1 in dark)

edited.use: The dot that marks edited: the title, a changed setting, the strip tile (3:1 in light)

viewer.use: Photo backdrop. Neutral and dark in both modes so photos read true

hud.use: Chrome drawn over the photo (pills, tags, chips, the drop and preview backdrops): a dark fill at 85 %, the same in both modes, as the photo's backdrop is

hud-border.use: The edge of chrome over the photo: white at 15 %, so it shows against a dark photo

hud-text.use: Text and icons on hud: 10.9:1 over a white photo, 17.3:1 over a black one

sans.use: System UI font everywhere (SF on Apple, Segoe UI on Windows)

mono.use: System monospace, for numbers that line up
